data.name: Bouzid
data.gender_notes: Bouzid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The one who guards, protects or safeguards
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word ‘baza’ which means to guard, Bouzid is a name that signifies protection and safeguarding. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic history, with many notable figures bearing this name. It is a name that inspires a sense of security, strength and resilience. The name Bouzid carries the meaning “The one who guards, protects or safeguards” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bouzid usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who guards, protects or safeguards and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies protection and guardianship, rooted in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Bouzid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who guards, protects or safeguards.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bouzid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بوزيد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جذر بوزيد، يعني زيادة في الخير والبركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بوزيد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من جذر 'بوزيد' الذي يعني زيادة في الخير والبركة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية ومرتبطة بالخصال الحميدة في الثقافة الإسلامية. استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض المناطق العربية، وخاصة في تونس والمغرب، كاسم للعائلات والأفراد، ويحمل في طياته دلالات من السخاء والكرم.

in_urdu.name: بوزید
in_urdu.meaning: نام بوزید کا مطلب ہے خیر و برکت میں اضافہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: بوزید ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خیر و برکت میں اضافہ۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اچھے معنیوں سے وابستہ ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے بعض اسلامی ممالک میں کیا جاتا ہے، جہاں یہ خاندانوں اور افراد کے نام کے طور پر پाया جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصیلی عربی جڑیں اسے سخاوت اور كرم کی علامت کے طور پر پیش کرتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बौज़िद
in_hindi.meaning: बौज़िद नाम का अर्थ है अच्छाई और आशीर्वाद में वृद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: बौज़िद एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है अच्छाई और आशीर्वाद में वृद्धि। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है और इसे अच्छे गुणों से जोड़ा जाता है। इस नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह उदारता और दयालुता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: بوزيد
in_pashto.meaning: د بوزيد نوم مطلب د خير او برکت د زياتش په معنا
in_pashto.long_meaning: بوزيد د يو مذکر نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. ددې نوم مطلب د خير او برکت د زياتش په معنا دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان په ځينو سيمو کې د عربي او اسلامي کلتور د نفوذ له امله کارول کېږي. د بوزيد نوم د عربي جذرونو له مخې د سخاوت او كرم په معنا دی.

in_english.name: Bouzid
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root, meaning increase in good and blessings
in_english.long_meaning: Bouzid is a masculine given name originating from Arabic. It is derived from the root 'Bouzid', which signifies an increase in goodness and blessings. This name is associated with positive connotations and good characteristics in Islamic culture. The etymology of Bouzid can be traced back to Arabic roots that imply generosity and kindness. Historically, the name has been used in various Arabic-speaking regions and Muslim communities worldwide. It symbolizes attributes of benevolence and magnanimity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bouzid carries a rich cultural heritage, often associated with valorous protectors in Islamic history. For instance, Bouzid, Al-Hadjjaj ibn Yusuf, was a prominent Umayyad governor who successfully defended the Muslims against various external threats and uprisings during the 8th century. The significance of Bouzid as a name in Muslim culture can therefore be attributed to its strong association with guardianship and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Bouzid represents the idea of being a protector and guardian of one's faith and moral values. It encourages Muslims to reflect on their role as protectors of their communities, families, and personal beliefs. Furthermore, it is a reminder of God's protection and provision as highlighted in various verses of the Quran. The name Bouzid is thus a powerful reminder to strive for personal and collective growth, while also being a shield against negative influences and distractions.

historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun was a prominent historian and sociologist. His work, 'The Muqaddimah', is considered a foundational text in the fields of history and sociology. In it, he describes the founding of the Marinid Dynasty by Bouzid ibn al-Rasit in Morocco.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqqari's 'Nafh al-Tib' records Bouzid ibn al-Kabir as a significant figure in the Almohad Empire in the 13th century, known for his military conquests and patronage of scholarship.
historical_references.context: Al-Maqqari was a Moroccan historian who wrote 'Nafh al-Tib', a historical work detailing the history of Morocco. In it, he describes Bouzid ibn al-Kabir as a powerful military leader and patron of learning in the Almohad Empire.
